title: Microsoft Teams: download manager with improved visibility and control
summary: The briefing passes: its description, status and scope match the launched roadmap item. The cited Teams licensing documentation supports the product-level entitlement, and independent searches found no documented download-manager switch, feature-specific licence or meter, default state or shortcut keys.
